pretend.description: Run but do not make any changes.

castle_path.description: The directory where castles are stored.

default_clone_url.description: A default git URL to clone castles from if not explicitly defined in the castle block.

castles.description: List of dotfile castles to track/symlink. Each item is a map with name, path, repository, and optional autolink settings. NOT a nested object properties schema, but a flat map of field definitions for the items in the list.

castles_items.description: Schema for items in the castles list. Note: In the values_schema, 'castles' uses this 'items' map to define the fields available in each list element. This is a structural definition for the list items, not a standalone variable used in the template directly via {{ castles_items }}.

castles_items_name.description: The name of the castle (used as the git repo directory name and identifier).

castles_items_path.description: The relative path from the home directory where the dotfiles should be symlinked.

castles_items_repository.description: The git repository URL for the castle.

castles_items_autolink.description: Automatically symlink the files upon cloning/linking.
